PluginData.Author: scotlandsyard
PluginData.Tooltip: Runs the BaR companion script for Nanobot Build and Repair in an in-game menu.
PluginData.Description:
The BaR companion script for the SKO Nanobot Build and Repair System as a client-side plugin, with an in-game menu instead of LCD panels.
- Queues the components your Build and Repair systems are missing into assemblers. - Shows weld and grind targets, missing components and priority lists live. - Handles any number of independent groups, and finds the systems by itself.
Needs the SKO maintained Nanobot Build and Repair mod (workshop 2111073562). Open it with /barmaid in chat.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/BaR%20Maid Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
